evidence: GTPlanet thread 'It's Chriiiiiiiistmas in GT Sport!!!' (posts dated 2018-12-21): Christmas menu music started at local midnight on 21 December; a player reported not hearing it the day before.
Posts in the same thread on 2018-12-25 still describe Christmas-only menu music.
MotoGamesTV recordings of the GT Sport Christmas menu were published 2019-12-20 17:15 PST, 2020-12-21 01:00 PST and 2022-12-20 15:48 PST, all of which are 21 December in Japan and Europe.
christmasWindow.approximation: The end date is not evidenced. No source shows when the Christmas playlist stopped, so the window ends on 25 December, the last date with direct reports. Use the Christmas setting to force it.

christmasMusic.summary: Update 1.10 (22 December 2017) added Christmas music to the main menu, and it came back each December. The in-game arrangements were never released commercially, so they play here as YouTube gameplay recordings of the actual menu.

menuMusic.summary: The menu BGM list comes from a GTPlanet community post (#134, 8 October 2017) that wrote down each title as it appeared in game. It is not an official list. Each track links to an official YouTube 'Topic' upload, where one could be matched automatically.
menuMusic.gaps: Some tracks have no matching Topic upload and are listed but skipped in YouTube mode. Later updates also changed the menu music: GTPlanet reported GT2-era menu music in GT League (update 1.10) and players reported older GT tracks added later. That later music is not catalogued here.
